content.text:
The Havlumi Valentine campaign ran for the full seven days, and spend came to $534.54 of your $550.00 budget. I can't see installs from here, so please check them against your own app reporting.

**Results (Feb 8 to Feb 14, Singapore time)**

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per link click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C: "Choose three photos…" | $205.78 | 476,834 | 408 | $0.50 |
| A: "Three photos, one little story" | $179.64 | 521,404 | 299 | $0.60 |
| B: Valentine Keepsake Pack | $149.12 | 426,687 | 233 | $0.64 |
| **Total** | **$534.54** | **1,424,925** | **940** | **$0.57** |

Link clicks are people who tapped through to havlumi.app/valentine. They are not installs.

**How I ran it**
- **Setup:** I used one campaign with three ad groups, one per approved post, each with a $183 total cap. I wrote no new posts.
- **Targeting:** All three ad groups targeted iPhone (iOS) only and excluded China. They also targeted English speakers, because the approved posts are in English (see the first point below).
- **Optimization:** The ad groups were optimized for link clicks, because X can't see your installs.
- **Mid-flight change (Feb 9):** After the first two days, post C had the most link clicks (95, against 82 for A and 74 for B). I raised C's total cap to $216 and lowered B's to $150. I left A unchanged. The campaign did not go over budget, and all three ad groups ended on schedule at midnight Singapore time on Feb 15.

**Observations**
- **Post C was the strongest.** Its cost per click stayed lowest and it drew the most clicks. A plain description of what the app does seems to have worked better here than the Valentine framing.
- **Post B was the weakest at getting clicks.** It still may bring in people who want the keepsake pack, so your install data is the real test.
- **Language:** The campaign reached English speakers only. You mentioned localized versions of each post, but I was only given these three English ones, so I didn't promote anything else. If you share the localized posts, a future flight could reach other markets.
- **Installs:** To see which post worked best, compare installs by source in your app reporting. I'd treat the cost-per-click ranking above as a hint, not a result.
